21/G.goal: Explain how AR software tools are organized by developer skill, target platform, or tracking technology, and how low-level and rapid-prototyping tools support AR application development.
21/G.achieves: It supports the course aim of enabling learners to understand and implement an XR system with confidence by establishing the AR software foundations.

21/O1.goal: Classify AR software tools by developer skill, target platform, or tracking technology, and describe the low-level and rapid-prototyping tool categories with representative examples.
21/O1.achieves: It gives the learner a foundational map of AR software tooling needed to select appropriate tools for later AR system design and implementation.
